column1: # lexicon-phrases.tsv — the load-bearing disambiguating PHRASES that the routing gate's R9 check
# asserts still appear in a member skill's `description:` after C5 compression (RFC context-routing).
# These are the free-text disambiguators the other checks CANNOT see: R4 sees only >=8-char IDENTICAL
# shared phrases; R8 syncs only family-ids. So compressing a description could silently drop the very
# phrase a collision family relies on — this file + R9 make that drift VISIBLE (a warn), not silent.
# Families map to scripts/routing/collisions.tsv — only the PHRASE-routed families are listed
# (C0/C4/C9/C10/C11); C1/C2/C3/C5/C6/C7/C8/C12 disambiguate by /command namespace and need no phrase.
# R9 requires, for each (family, member) group: AT LEAST ONE listed phrase survives in the member's
# description (case-insensitive substring, whitespace-normalised). Remove a row ONLY as a deliberate
# decision when a phrase is intentionally reworded — that keeps the drift a conscious edit.
